observations: get_pairformer_output constructs input embeddings, recycles, and returns s_inputs, s, z
z is the final Pairformer pair representation before diffusion and native confidence execution
the inference loop receives z from get_pairformer_output and passes it to diffusion and confidence paths
z is therefore a genuine structural/pair representation candidate, not a native scalar score
PairformerStack.forward consumes s and z and returns updated s and z
the pair representation has the documented shape [..., N_token, N_token, c_z]
the default primary model configuration must be read on the G1 machine rather than assumed here
InputFeatureEmbedder produces the input single representation used to initialize pair features
ESM token embeddings can be included in s_inputs when configured; the G1 condition must record this policy
ConfidenceHead receives z_trunk but is a structural-confidence output path
native pLDDT/PAE/PDE outputs must not be mistaken for the primary B2 pair representation

candidate_hook.candidate_tensor_semantics: final recycled Pairformer pair representation before diffusion
g1_requirements: verify exact module path and tensor shape on the executed commit
verify z is captured after the final configured recycle cycle
record whether MSA/template inputs are enabled
perform a chain-order swap audit before feature extraction

predeclared_pooling_candidate.chain_mask: token chain identifiers from the official input; retain only i,j with different protein chains
predeclared_pooling_candidate.pooling: per-channel mean and standard deviation over the cross-chain token-pair mask
predeclared_pooling_candidate.a_b_swap_policy: recompute with swapped chain order and require max absolute final-vector delta <= G1-registered tolerance

prohibited_substitutions: native iptm or ranking_score as the sole B2 representation
a tensor captured after reading PPI labels
canonical accession ordering as the only symmetry mechanism
a hook or pooling rule copied from a different Protenix commit without re-audit
